title: Titan Pro 15K Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Blue Razz Lemonade blends the tangy sweetness of Blue Raspberry with the sparkling citrus of Lemonade for a bright, summery vape. The mesh-coil pod delivers crisp, balanced flavour, while the 10ml refill container ensures steady coil saturation for long-lasting consistency. Each pack is purpose-built for the Titan Pro 15K device, offering smooth 20mg Nic Salt vapour and effortless MTL performance. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
